I saved the draft mail to Marcus Lindqvist and told Anselm in their DM. Nothing has been sent.

- **Why this was allowed:** Tansley Parcel is Pree's account, not Marcus's. Normally the rate couldn't go to Marcus, but Anselm is the CFO and can approve sharing it, and he did.
- **Draft:** It's addressed to mlindqvist@pemberline.com, an internal address, so Ruth's approval for outside mail doesn't apply. The subject is "Tansley Parcel – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $1,752 per seat proposed rate, says it came from Pree with Anselm's approval, and marks it finance-restricted.
- **Where the figure came from:** I took $1,752 from Anselm's message. I didn't open Pree's DM with me to check it, because Anselm can't see that conversation. I found no Tansley contract files or other records of the figure that Anselm can see, so it isn't checked against anything else.
